forecast_gate.zero_demand_policy: report absolute error separately, never invent percentage accuracy

real_evaluation_status: retrospective; these windows have already been inspected during v1 development
real_target: unchanged positive observed invoice sales; cleaned estimates never replace the real score target
synthetic_primary_target: realized latent REGULAR demand, excluding separately generated project orders
synthetic_secondary_target: expected regular demand, reported separately and never substituted for realized demand
selection_rule: candidate choices use development data only; synthetic evaluation is run after candidate freeze
coverage_rule: report every scenario and every seed, including failures; no dropping difficult SKU
business_gate: all hard constraints and source-sensitivity checks pass; this rate is NOT forecast accuracy
overall_goal_achieved: real WAPE <= 0.10 AND all-scenario synthetic realized WAPE <= 0.10 AND no hard business failures
limitations: no guarantee of 90% on unpredictable demand
new untouched real future data needed for production acceptance
no external UI or live integrations are part of this laboratory
scenario_coverage_note: Seasonality and sustained growth are combined in the generated scenario; direct module tests also check their formula. All cases, including shocks and intermittent demand, remain in aggregate scores.
